headline: Gas Withdrawals from UGS Rise to 47 mcm/day with Reserves at 15.6 bcm
summary: Gas withdrawals from Ukraine's underground gas storage facilities gradually rose to 47 million cubic meters per day by the end of last week. Reserves stood at 15.6 billion cubic meters.
why: Ukraine's gas storage levels determine how well the country can meet winter heating demand and its reliance on imports. Storage data also influences European gas prices.
